text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A, D, E and C above my average costs felt rewarding, but I should consider whether each still fits my plan before locking in a gain.","A few months without trades did not prevent my account value from moving; I should not treat doing nothing as protection from market swings.","I tend to judge each stock against its own cost and feel the sting of losses, so I should also look at my whole portfolio and keep decisions aligned with my long-term needs."]}
